name: humagent
description: Comment on, rewrite, and answer local pages and apps, then send your AI agent structured feedback.

scripts.build: bun --bun vite build && bun --bun vite build src/examples
scripts.lint: bun lint --no-script src test scripts vite.config.ts
scripts.format: bun fmt --no-script src test scripts vite.config.ts tsconfig*.json package.json turbo.json toolchain.json lefthook.yml
scripts.format:check: bun fmt --no-script --check src test scripts vite.config.ts tsconfig*.json package.json turbo.json toolchain.json lefthook.yml
scripts.typecheck: bun check --no-script && bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.test.json && bun check --no-script -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: turbo run format:check lint build typecheck test:fast --continue=$([ -n "$CI" ] && echo never || echo dependencies-successful)
scripts.prepublishOnly: playwright install --with-deps --only-shell chromium && bun run test --force

author: Georgii Bukharov
